name: Libni
overview: Libni was a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the son of Mahli. He belonged to the Mahlite family, which descended from Merari, one of Levi's sons. His lineage places him within the Levitical priestly heritage, emphasizing his role in the tribe of Levi.
namesAndTitles: The name Libni means '[descendant of] Libni or white,' reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. This name was not given directly by God but was established within the family line, as noted in 1 Chronicles 6:29.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Libni as the son of Mahli and infers that his grandfather was Shimei. These relationships place him firmly within the Mahlite branch of the Levites but do not extend beyond these immediate family connections.
scriptureSignificance: Libni's significance lies in his place within the Levitical genealogies, particularly as a Mahlite descendant of Levi through Merari. This lineage is crucial for understanding the organization and duties of the Levites in Israel. By tracing Libni's ancestry, the biblical text highlights the continuity and faithfulness of God's covenant people through the tribe of Levi.
